name: Test Harness & Smoke Tests
description: Vitest test harness configuration and smoke test suite for the exemplar.tools documentation website. Provides: (1) vitest configuration surface via vite.config.ts test block and src/__tests__/setup.ts with jsdom environment and @testing-library/jest-dom matchers, (2) data layer smoke tests validating the canonical ToolDefList array (length === 11, slug order matches ToolSlug enum, required field presence/typing, kindex videoUrl undefined, vacuous truth guard for videoUrl existence), (3) component render smoke test using @testing-library/react with MemoryRouter wrapping and optional Convex mock, (4) devDependency contract (vitest, jsdom, @testing-library/react v14+, @testing-library/jest-dom installed via bun add -d), (5) execution contract ensuring `bunx vitest run` exits 0 and package.json scripts include "test": "vitest run".

functions.name: configureVitestSetup
functions.description: Creates src/__tests__/setup.ts that imports @testing-library/jest-dom for extended matchers and stubs browser globals (e.g., window.matchMedia) absent in jsdom. This file is referenced by vite.config.ts test.setupFiles.

error_data.resolution: Ensure vite.config.ts exists. Project must be initialized with bun create vite.

preconditions: devDependencies vitest, jsdom, @testing-library/react (>=14.0.0), and @testing-library/jest-dom are installed via bun add -d

functions.name: assertToolDefListLength
functions.description: Asserts that the imported ToolDefList array has exactly 11 entries. This is the foundational data integrity check — all other data tests depend on this invariant.

inputs.name: toolDefList
inputs.description: The canonical ToolDefList array imported from the data layer module.

error_cases.name: length_mismatch
error_cases.condition: toolDefList.length !== 11

error_data.detail: ToolDefList must contain exactly 11 entries, one per exemplar tool

error_cases.name: import_failure
error_cases.condition: ToolDefList import resolves to undefined or is not an array

error_data.resolution: Verify that the data layer module exports ToolDefList as a named export of type ToolDef[]

preconditions: toolDefList is imported from the data layer module and is a defined array

functions.name: assertSlugOrder
functions.description: Asserts that the slugs in ToolDefList appear in exact pipeline order: constrain, ledger, pact, advocate, arbiter, baton, sentinel, chronicler, stigmergy, apprentice, kindex. Uses ordered array comparison, not set equality.

error_cases.name: slug_order_mismatch
error_cases.condition: The slug at any index i does not match expectedSlugs[i]

error_data.detail: Slugs must appear in exact pipeline order

error_cases.name: unknown_slug
error_cases.condition: A slug value is not a member of the ToolSlug enum

error_data.detail: All slugs must be valid ToolSlug enum variants

postconditions: TestResult.passed === true iff toolDefList.map(t => t.slug) deep-equals expectedSlugs

functions.name: assertRequiredFieldsPerTool
functions.description: Uses describe.each over all 11 ToolDefList entries to assert each has the required fields: name (non-empty string), description (non-empty string), step (number 1–11), version (non-empty string), accentColor (string matching /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/). Each field is individually asserted for precise failure diagnostics.

inputs.name: toolDef
inputs.description: A single tool definition entry from ToolDefList, checked against the ToolRequiredFields shape.

error_cases.name: missing_name
error_cases.condition: toolDef.name is undefined, null, or empty string

error_cases.name: missing_description
error_cases.condition: toolDef.description is undefined, null, or empty string

error_cases.name: invalid_step
error_cases.condition: toolDef.step is not an integer or is outside range [1, 11]

error_cases.name: missing_version
error_cases.condition: toolDef.version is undefined, null, or empty string

error_cases.name: invalid_accent_color
error_cases.condition: toolDef.accentColor does not match /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/

preconditions: toolDef is a defined object (not null/undefined)
postconditions: TestResult.passed === true iff all of: toolDef.name is a non-empty string, toolDef.description is a non-empty string, toolDef.step is an integer in [1,11], toolDef.version is a non-empty string, toolDef.accentColor matches /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/

functions.name: assertKindexNoVideoUrl
functions.description: Asserts that the tool entry with slug 'kindex' has videoUrl === undefined. This is a specific business rule: kindex does not have an associated video.

error_cases.name: kindex_not_found
error_cases.condition: No entry in toolDefList has slug === 'kindex'

error_data.detail: ToolDefList must contain a kindex entry

error_cases.name: kindex_has_video_url
error_cases.condition: The kindex entry has a defined, non-undefined videoUrl

error_data.detail: kindex.videoUrl must be undefined per business rule

preconditions: toolDefList contains an entry with slug === 'kindex'
postconditions: TestResult.passed === true iff toolDefList.find(t => t.slug === 'kindex').videoUrl === undefined

functions.name: assertAtLeastOneVideoUrl
functions.description: Asserts that at least one tool in ToolDefList has a defined videoUrl. This prevents vacuous truth in the kindex assertion — if no tool has videoUrl, the kindex check would pass trivially and mask a data layer defect.

error_cases.name: no_video_urls
error_cases.condition: No tool in ToolDefList has a defined videoUrl

error_data.detail: At least one tool must have a videoUrl to prevent vacuous truth in kindex assertion

postconditions: TestResult.passed === true iff toolDefList.some(t => t.videoUrl !== undefined)

functions.name: renderWithProviders
functions.description: Test utility function that renders a React component wrapped in MemoryRouter (for React Router context) and optionally mocks convex/react hooks at module level. Returns @testing-library/react RenderResult. Exported for reuse across future test files.

inputs.name: component
inputs.description: A React element (JSX) to render, e.g. <ToolCard tool={mockTool} />.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Configuration for the test render context.

error_cases.name: render_throws
error_cases.condition: The component throws during render (e.g., missing required context, undefined prop access)

error_data.detail: Component render must complete without throwing. Check that all required providers and props are supplied.

error_cases.name: missing_router_context
error_cases.condition: Component uses useNavigate/useParams/Link but MemoryRouter wrapper is missing or misconfigured

error_data.detail: Ensure MemoryRouter wraps components that use React Router hooks or components.

preconditions: component is a valid React element
postconditions: Returned RenderResult.container is a mounted DOM node
If options.mockConvex is true, convex/react useQuery and useMutation are replaced with no-op stubs

structured_side_effects.description: Mounts a React component tree into the jsdom virtual DOM for assertion

functions.name: smokeTestComponentRender
functions.description: Smoke test that picks a simple presentational component (one that does not depend on Convex hooks, or uses Convex hooks that are mocked), wraps it via renderWithProviders, and asserts: (1) render completes without throwing, (2) a known text element is present in the rendered output. This validates the test harness end-to-end from jsdom environment through React rendering to DOM query.

inputs.name: componentUnderTest
inputs.description: The React element to render, typically a simple presentational component like a sidebar item or tool card with mock props.

inputs.name: expectedTextContent
inputs.description: A text string expected to appear in the rendered output, used for getByText assertion.

error_cases.name: render_error
error_cases.condition: Component throws during React render lifecycle

error_data.detail: Smoke test failed: component threw during render

error_cases.name: text_not_found
error_cases.condition: getByText(expectedTextContent) throws because no matching DOM node exists

error_data.detail: Expected text content not found in rendered output

error_cases.name: convex_hook_not_mocked
error_cases.condition: Component transitively imports convex/react hooks that are not mocked, causing runtime error in test environment

error_data.resolution: Pass { mockConvex: true } to renderWithProviders or mock convex/react at module level with vi.mock

preconditions: jsdom environment is configured via vitest
src/__tests__/setup.ts has been loaded (jest-dom matchers available)
componentUnderTest is a valid React element with all required props supplied
postconditions: TestResult.passed === true iff render completes without throwing AND getByText(expectedTextContent) returns a DOM node
Rendered component tree is unmounted after assertion (cleanup)

structured_side_effects.description: Renders and then unmounts a React component tree in jsdom

functions.name: executeTestSuite
functions.description: Runs the full smoke test suite via `bunx vitest run` (or equivalently `bun run test`). This is the top-level execution contract: all test files matching src/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx} are discovered, run in jsdom environment, and the aggregate result is produced. Exit code 0 means all tests pass.

error_data.resolution: Verify vite.config.ts test block matches VitestConfigBlock shape

error_data.resolution: Run configureVitestSetup to create the setup file

error_cases.name: bun_not_found

error_data.detail: Inspect TestSuiteResult.results for individual failure messages

error_cases.name: jsdom_import_failure

preconditions: vite.config.ts contains a valid test configuration block
src/__tests__/setup.ts exists and is referenced in test.setupFiles
All devDependencies are installed: vitest, jsdom, @testing-library/react (>=14.0.0), @testing-library/jest-dom
postconditions: TestSuiteResult.totalTests >= 15 (minimum: 11 field checks via describe.each + length + slug order + kindex videoUrl + vacuous truth guard + 1 component render)

structured_side_effects.description: Discovers and reads all test files matching the include glob
Loads the vitest setup file before each test file
Reads vitest configuration from the test block
Vitest outputs test results, pass/fail counts, and timing to stdout

performance_budget.complexity: O(n) where n = number of test cases

invariants: ToolDefList always contains exactly 11 entries — no more, no fewer
Slug order in ToolDefList is fixed to the pipeline order: constrain, ledger, pact, advocate, arbiter, baton, sentinel, chronicler, stigmergy, apprentice, kindex
Every ToolDef entry has defined, non-empty name, description, version, a valid step in [1,11], and accentColor matching /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/
At least one tool (not kindex) has a defined videoUrl
All test files are discovered under src/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx}
vitest environment is always jsdom — never node or happy-dom
src/__tests__/setup.ts is always the first file in test.setupFiles
All packages are installed exclusively via bun — never npm, yarn, or npx
bunx vitest run and bun run test produce identical results
Component render tests always wrap in MemoryRouter when the component under test uses React Router

data_access.rationale: Reads the PUBLIC-tier ToolDefList data array (tool names, descriptions, slugs, step numbers, version strings, accent colors, video URLs) from the data layer module to validate its structure and content in smoke tests. Reads project configuration files (vite.config.ts, package.json) to set up and verify test infrastructure. No PII, INTERNAL, or sensitive data is accessed. No data is written to any persistent store — file writes are limited to project configuration artifacts (setup.ts, vite.config.ts test block, package.json scripts).

side_effects.rationale: Writes test infrastructure configuration files: setup.ts (jest-dom import + matchMedia stub), vite.config.ts test block (vitest config), and package.json scripts entry. These are development-only artifacts not deployed to production.
Reads source data modules to import ToolDefList for assertion and reads component source files to render them in smoke tests.
Spawns a vitest child process via bun to execute the test suite. The process reads test files, runs assertions in jsdom, and outputs results to stdout.

authority.rationale: This component is the single authoritative owner of vitest configuration (vite.config.ts test block shape, setup file content, test file discovery globs) and test assertion logic (what constitutes a passing data smoke test, which fields are required, what the slug order is). Other components produce the data and UI; this component exclusively defines how they are verified.
